test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Megasthenes was a Greek ambassador in the court of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Chandragupta Maurya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya:**

 
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** was the founder of the** Maurya Empire in ancient India**.
 
• He built one of the largest-ever empires on the **Indian subcontinent **and then, according to **Jain sources**, he renounced it all to become a **Jain monk**.
 
• **Megasthenes **served as an **ambassador of Seleucus I of Syria to the court of Chandragupta Maurya.**
 
• His observations were recorded in his work called **'Indica'.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pushyamitra Shunga:**

 
 
• He was a ruler of the **Shunga Empire in North India, after he overthrew the Maurya Empire**.
 
• **Pushyamitra Shunga** ruled for **36 years** and was succeeded by his son** Agnimitra**.
 
 
 
• **Harshvardhana**:
 
 
• Also known as **Harsha,** he was an I**ndian emperor who ruled North India from 606 to 647 CE.**
 
• He was the son of **Prabhakarvardhana **and the** younger brother of Rajyavardhana, a king of Thanesar, Haryana.**
 
• **Megasthenes **did not serve in **his court, as his time was much later than that of Megasthenes.**
 
 
 
• **Ashoka**:
 
 
• **Ashoka** was an** Indian emperor of the Maurya Dynasty who ruled almost all of the Indian subcontinent from c. 268 to 232 BCE.**
 
• One of **India's greatest emperors, Ashoka reigned over a realm that stretched from the Hindu Kush mountains in the west to Bengal in the East and covered the entire Indian subcontinent except parts of present-day Tamil Nadu and Kerala.**
